description: Avoid single-character variable names — they hurt readability
Cache repeated database lookups inside the request loop
Never interpolate raw user input directly into SQL queries
Separate business logic from I/O and keep functions small and single-purpose
Validate and sanitize all external input at the trust boundary
Avoid N+1 queries — batch or join instead
Use descriptive names and consistent casing per language conventions
Handle errors explicitly and never swallow exceptions silently
Never hard-code credentials or API keys in source code
Do not build strings with concatenation inside tight loops
